businessOverview.title: Business Overview
businessOverview.description: Provide basic information about your business and project. This information will be used throughout your DPR.
businessOverview.projectNameHint: A clear, descriptive name for your project (e.g., "Organic Spice Processing Unit")
businessOverview.industrySectorHint: Select the primary industry sector your business belongs to
businessOverview.businessDescriptionItems: Products or services you will produce/offer, Business model and how you will operate, Unique value proposition and competitive advantages, Production capacity or service volume, Business objectives and goals, Target customers and market approach

assist.helperText: After filling this step, run a review of these fields only. Chat appears after analysis.
assist.customInstructionsHint: This prompt controls how Analyze and step chat think. Edit it, then run Analyze. Reset restores the default mentor prompt.
assist.suggestionsHint: Figures that look fine are left as they are. We only flag amounts that may be high or low, plus optional ways to keep the starting budget down.
assist.chatOpenerImprovements: Here's how these figures look to me:
assist.chatOpenerAsk: Want to talk through any of these?
assist.analyzeFailed: Could not analyze this step. Please try again.
assist.chatFailed: Could not send your message. Please try again.

dprBuilder.clickApplyToUse: Click "Apply All" to use the AI-generated suggestions. You can edit them after applying.

marketAnalysis.title: Market Analysis
marketAnalysis.description: Analyze your target market, competition, and opportunities. Use AI to generate sample content that you can edit.
marketAnalysis.targetMarketItems: Primary and secondary customer segments, Geographic coverage (local, regional, national, export), Market size estimates with numbers/percentages, Distribution channels (retail, online, wholesale, etc.), Customer demographics and buying patterns
marketAnalysis.competitorAnalysisItems: Main competitors in your market, Their strengths, weaknesses, and market share, Pricing strategies and product positioning, Your unique competitive advantages, How you differentiate from competitors
marketAnalysis.clickApplyToUse: Click "Apply" next to each field to use the AI-generated sample content. You can edit it after applying.

costStructure.title: Cost Structure
costStructure.description: Define your CAPEX (Capital Expenditure) and OPEX (Operating Expenditure) requirements. Use AI to generate sample values.
costStructure.capexItems: Land purchase or lease costs, Building construction or renovation, Machinery and equipment purchase, Installation and setup costs, Pre-operative expenses (licenses, registration)
costStructure.opexItems: Raw materials and inventory, Employee salaries and wages, Utilities (electricity, water, gas), Rent and maintenance, Marketing and administrative expenses
costStructure.landBuildingHint: Include land cost, building construction, and related infrastructure
costStructure.machineryHint: Include all production machinery, tools, and equipment costs
costStructure.rawMaterialsHint: Monthly cost of raw materials needed for production
costStructure.salariesHint: Total monthly salary for all employees
costStructure.clickApplyToUseValues: Click "Apply" next to each field or "Apply All" to use the AI-generated values. You can edit them after applying.

financialProjections.title: Financial Projections
financialProjections.description: Project your revenue, costs, and cash flow for the next 3-5 years. AI-generated projections are pre-filled based on your project details. You can edit any values as needed.
financialProjections.creatingRealisticProjections: Creating realistic projections based on your project details...
financialProjections.editValuesDirectly: Edit values directly in the table below
financialProjections.revenueCalculationDesc: Based on your project cost, we estimate Year 1 revenue at ~70% of total investment, growing at 12% annually.
financialProjections.costStructureDesc: Includes your operating expenses (OPEX), depreciation on fixed assets, and loan interest payments.
financialProjections.profitCalculationDesc: Profit = Revenue - Costs. Positive values mean profit, negative values indicate initial losses (common in early years).
financialProjections.aimForBreakEvenDesc: Try to achieve break-even (revenue = costs) by Year 2-3 for better bank approval chances.
financialProjections.reviewRegularlyDesc: Update projections as you get more accurate cost estimates or market data.
financialProjections.beRealisticDesc: Conservative projections are better than overly optimistic ones for loan applications.
